args.content: This is a valid Variation if the Engineer instructs it under clause 13.1, because the Engineer may vary the Works before completion, including by revised drawing, and each Variation must be confirmed by a Variation Instruction. It should be valued under clause 13.3 by measuring the change in quantities and using the Bill of Quantities rate where the paving is of similar character and executed under similar conditions; a new rate is only for any part with no similar item. Clause 13.4 bars any percentage addition for preliminaries or overheads, and clause 14.2 means any LS item is not remeasured. If the Variation delays completion, clause 8.4 gives EOT only to the extent of delay on the current programme by critical path and float, and clause 8.5 pays AED 2,500 [F-0511] per working day of extension granted, with no other time-related costs. Acceleration is only by Employer instruction under clause 8.6, with AED 3,000 [F-0513] mobilisation per additional crew per activity and AED 1,800 [F-0514] per crew per working day. Notice under clause 20.1 is within 28 [F-0515] days. Design responsibility for structural design sits with the Employer’s design consultant under clause 4.1; this paving change does not itself raise a structural design question on the contract text, but any revised drawing remains an Engineer instruction issue under clause 13.1.
